answer_2.quote: We obtain 7000 data points for each trait (7 LLM architectures × 1000 simulated conversations per architecture), and train models on an 80-20 train-test split. Table  shows the models' R 2 and RMSE values for the test data.

answer_3.quote: To test this, we sample 500 conversations and conduct a test where GPT-4o mini is shown conversations and asked to identify the user's assigned personality from four choices.
